WITH obs_telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    count,
    CAST(count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM obs_telescope_counts) as share
  FROM obs_telescope_counts
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT count, share FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as avg_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg FROM overall_avg) as avg_excess_share
FROM above_avg
